items.text: Read the existing security audit so the new pass does not repeat fixed ground
Attack authentication and session handling (login, refresh, reset, OAuth, role escalation)
Attack authorization on every API route (guest, host, admin) for cross-account access
Attack input handling: injection, SSRF, XSS, open redirect, path traversal, uploads
Attack money and booking integrity plus rate limiting and abuse controls
Verify each candidate finding by reading the real code path
Write the findings and prioritized remediation plan to docs
Fix the highest-risk confirmed issues with regression tests
Run lint, production build and server test suite
